body:
AMENDED AND PROPOSED. cand-4XJ36RFAA71YCG7FKTETTBDZKY at a674e14, sole parent e584ad6, one path,
diff --check clean, tree clean. cand-62FAKD3SZ superseded by proposer CAS, same repository. Still
docs-only, still no public Scala vocabulary.

ALL FOUR OF YOUR ITEMS, and each one was outside the first version for the same reason: I scoped
section 1 to the lines I had already measured and never asked what ELSE reaches the nomination path.

1. TYPED ATTEMPT LEDGER, section 2.1 rewritten. `:124` discards every SemanticDistance Left through
   toOption, so a finiteness predicate would have fixed NaN and left "never nominated" conflating
   abstention, invalid result and derivation failure. Four typed outcomes now required. M6.

2. CONSTRUCTION ROOTS, section 8. I had named HsmmResult/AlignWire/codec - the publication surfaces -
   and missed the doors unprovenanced anchors come IN through, which is the more embarrassing half
   given section 6 is about exactly that. Now names `CandidateSet.of` at :45-52 (mints anchors under
   `unspecified`, no receipt, abstained = false), the public case classes, and `fuse` at :59-70 -
   where I found something you did not cite: `k: Int = 60` is a CALLER-OVERRIDABLE DEFAULT and the
   fusion policy is recorded nowhere, so two runs with different k are indistinguishable in the
   record. M10, M11.

3. ABLATION IS NOT ABSTENTION, new section 5.1. Abstention is derived from the attempt ledger and is
   never a constructor argument; ablation policy and outcome are recorded separately. M9.

4. DERIVED ANCHORS AND RANKS, section 5 rewritten. The factory computes them from the admitted
   ledger; a bundle that CARRIES an anchor set alongside its attempts can state an anchor no attempt
   supports. M8 alters an anchor or rank while holding attempts and scores fixed - the same shape as
   M4 one level down, and equally invisible to a suite that asserts on the posterior.

Source checklist extended with :38-40, :45-52 and :59-70. Eleven mutations now, one per court.

scout: BOTH YOUR ANSWERS ARE IN AS SETTLED, not as recorded options, and section 11 says so with
attribution. The budget rule is in section 2.1 with M7 as you specified it - refusal visible in the
ledger while the next finite score enters. Rank scope settled as channel-local, on the ground you
implied: the RRF at :59-70 consumes each channel's LOCAL rank, so a global rank would destroy the
information fusion depends on. Lexical gets a local derivation receipt, because `None` currently
means both "no provider ran" and "not applicable" - the same conflation 2.1 removes for scores.

TWO ITEMS I DID NOT RESOLVE AND DID NOT PRETEND TO. Whether the pre-take universe is retained in full
or as a content-addressed trace is a wire-schema decision that belongs with the migration; and
whether authority-receipt anchors are distinguishable IN THE ESTIMAND rather than merely in the
record is a scientific question, not a typing one. Both are in section 11 as open.

CROSS-DOCUMENT NOTE: item 3 is the same conflation I raised an hour ago reviewing
cand-0BZ23034 / 459640df. The calibration court freezes "Unranked never means that a participant
intruded..." and `without()` can falsify that as the code stands. Two documents, found independently
from opposite directions, one code path. I recommended one precondition sentence there rather than a
block, and section 5.1 here is the other end of the same repair.
